title: Compatible strict henselization core data without final residue square
statement: The compatible strict henselization rings, maps, universal homeomorphisms, structural equalities and residue factorizations exist.

proof.text: Apply the upstream core-existence theorem at sigma and tau to obtain the henselian rings, separably closed residue fields, presentations of strictLocalization, and universal-homeomorphism residue maps. Derive s = t composed with g from h_iota by associativity and apply upstream core completion to these presentations. The canonical comparison smallStrictHenselizationColimitIso identifies the small coordinate-ring colimit with the large affine-neighbourhood colimit. Apply Spec to this isomorphism and compose the presentations with it. The final-functor colimit injection formula identifies the cone legs. Composing any leg with its affine neighbourhood structure map proves that the comparison carries strictHenselizationStructuralMap to strictLocalizationToBase. Rewrite the structural square and both residue factorizations using this equality and associativity, then assemble the original witnesses with the transported spectrum isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Tags 04HX, 03PS, 04GU and 04DY; F1 2026-10-20: upstream core theorems and canonical affine-colimit comparison, preserving the small-colimit statement

lean.statement:
theorem Etale.exists_compatibleStrictHenselizationCoreData
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} {g : T ⟶ S}
    {k k' Ω : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k] [Field k'] [IsSepClosed k']
    [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (σ : Spec (.of k) ⟶ S) (τ : Spec (.of k') ⟶ T)
    (ι : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (hι : ι ≫ σ = τ ≫ g)
    (hσ : ∃ (s : S) (ψ : S.residueField s ⟶ .of k),
      ψ.hom.IsIntegral ∧ Spec.map ψ ≫ S.fromSpecResidueField s = σ)
    (hτ : ∃ (t : T) (ψ : T.residueField t ⟶ .of k'),
      ψ.hom.IsIntegral ∧ Spec.map ψ ≫ T.fromSpecResidueField t = τ)
    (ν : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of k')) :
    let s := ν ≫ ι ≫ σ
    let t := ν ≫ τ
    ∃ (A B : Type u) (cA : CommRing A) (cB : CommRing B),
      letI := cA
      letI := cB
      ∃ (hA : HenselianLocalRing A) (hB : HenselianLocalRing B),
        letI := hA
        letI := hB
        ∃ (sA : IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A))
          (sB : IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)),
          letI := sA
          letI := sB
          ∃ (φ : A →+* B) (hφ : IsLocalHom φ),
            letI := hφ
            ∃ (eA : Spec (.of A) ≅ strictHenselizationScheme s)
              (eB : Spec (.of B) ≅ strictHenselizationScheme t)
              (ρA : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)))
              (ρB : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B))),
              IsUniversalHomeomorphism ρA ∧ IsUniversalHomeomorphism ρB ∧
              Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ eA.hom ≫
                strictHenselizationStructuralMap s =
                eB.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap t ≫ g ∧
              ρA ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue A)) ≫
                eA.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap s = σ ∧
              ρB ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue B)) ≫
                eB.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap t = τ
